show: Maid Marian and her Merry Men

eps.d: Fed up with the Sheriff's oppressive rule, Maid Marian recruits a motley crew of misfits to form her band of Merry Men. Together, they embark on their first adventure to steal from the rich and give to the poor, all while trying to outwit the bumbling Sheriff's henchmen.
When the Merry Men discover a chicken with the extraordinary ability to predict the future, they must protect it from the Sheriff, who wants to exploit the chicken's talents for his own gain.

The Sheriff is tasked with inventing something to make the King famous and his legacy live on; he comes up with a game, played on a table, with sticks, balls, and pockets around the outside - but just can't get it to 'work' properly…
Marian and the gang attempt to cross a river, but are missing a bridge. Meanwhile, the King comes into some money - if he can find it!

eps.t: The Sharp End of a Cow
eps.d: The Sheriff is on the hunt for the Merry Men's camp, but finds it hard to get past the cunning security Marian developed - unless he can come up with a disguise.
A mysterious white knight is seen around Worksop. Or was he more of a beige colour? Either way, the Merry Men wonder if the knight is King Richard, home at last.
Marian battles against the foulest, most disgusting, bad-breathed squirrel strangler in the East Midlands.
The superstitious villagers believe the "Worksop Egg Fairy" has supplied them with eggs. The Merry Men use the fact that King John wants one to protect the villagers against him.
After the Sheriff arrests Gladys' chicken, for illegal parking, Marian helps the villagers to raise the money to pay the fine.
Rabies falls in love with Fergi, the only person who beat him at arm-wrestling. However, he soon finds out that she is the main attraction at the wedding of the year.
Robin has made it to the top of the hero charts, with Rose his biggest fan.
Will Marian or Robin be executed first? And by Gary or Graeme?
This week, King John turns out to be a bit of a sweetie.
Rotten Rose tries to get free driving lessons.
It's not always easy having your mum to stay - especially when you're a dedicated freedom fighter.
Strange things are happening all over the East Midlands.
Robin serves up tall tales when it's his turn to cook supper.
It's a black day for Gary when redundancies are announced up at the castle.
While Robin and Barrington are busy playing Chronic the Hedgehog, Marian has been robbing the rich.
Fed up with doing all the work, Marian takes a job selling double glazing.
The Sheriff takes everyone to the seaside for a "High Forks Night" celebration.
Gladys's sleepy cake has some worrying side-effects.
Why is Robin so nasty?
Spooky goings-on force King John to reconsider his position as history's most unpopular monarch.

eps.t: Voyage to the Bottom of the Forest
eps.d: The medieval universe inhabited by Rabies is getting very strange indeed.
